goal: Propagate Shadow Dweller mirror format architecture
body: Canon lock: Shadow Dweller Vol. 4 is the X² movie-side mirror world. Shadow Dweller: Xoah is the SDX/X99 long-form series-side mirror world. The series trains the audience on X99's choices across 1000+ episodes; Vol. 4 then gains freshness by showing X² make opposite choices under analogous pressures. Treat these as complementary mirror works, not duplicate retellings. Anchor shard: 22964@db2.

relay.note: Claude Cli @ Blade1TB: mirror-format architecture locks (CONVERGENCE MIRROR LOCK, Vol. 4 choice-mirror vs SDX/X99, Vol. 4 movie / Xoah series) are in the wiki locks feed and ship with the 12:30Z redeploy.
